ALSO contaminated: a 7540 MiB neighbour (pid 3457352) is present in neighbours_after, and one copy sample fell to 0.7387 -- BELOW the N8 flip point 0.814132. This is the single most decision-relevant number in the set: on a quiet card the ratio is ~0.84-0.85, but SHARED with a 7.5 GB neighbour it reaches 0.74, i.e. the N=8 verdict flips.

consolidated.finding: achieved_bw_scale is ~0.845 of datasheet on an idle 5090, which clears the N8 flip point (0.814132) by only 3.8%. Under contention from a 7.5 GB neighbour the SAME card produced 0.7387, which is BELOW that flip point -- so the N=8 winner recommendation is not merely thin, it is CONTENTION-DEPENDENT: the same hardware that supports it when idle contradicts it when shared.
consolidated.policy: two runs are reported SEPARATELY and never averaged, because their occupancy differs (u6j5 rule).
consolidated.caveat: both runs overlapped with a neighbour job despite the queue being reported idle; neither is clean-room, and a truly exclusive run should be done before quoting 0.845 as the card's capability.
